items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I knew he had no principles at all

ctx.x: Because, see, I hate to see guys like him abandon jazz, like Symphony Sid, I knew he had no principles at all, you know, he was at a party once at Billy Eckstine's apartment and Ted's mother was there, and they put an

Art Tatum record on the thing, and he didn't know who the piano player was. And in those days, nobody sounded like Art Tatum. Nobody remotely. And he was the top, head man of the be bop movement, Symphony Sid, the hippest jazz jock -- and he didn't know who the piano player was.
